old_value: {"id":"jmap-chat-spec-9wz3","title":"Federation: transient attachment fetch failure permanently drops message","description":"Found 2026-10-20 (avatar discussion). New Message Validation step 11 rejects Peer/deliver with invalidArguments if an attachment fetch fails, including transient failures (sender's blob server down, timeout). invalidArguments is permanent (Error Handling: do not retry), so the sender never retries and the message is lost. Proposed (Mark agreed direction): classify failures - a fetch that fails transiently returns a retryable error so delivery is retried with backoff; a size or sha256 mismatch stays permanent. Unlike avatars (now best-effort), attachments are part of the message, so best-effort is wrong here.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-20T22:04:35.896110734Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-20T22:04:35.896110734Z"}

new_value: Step 11 classifies attachment fetch failures: connection/timeout/5xx -> serverFail (retried), 429 -> rateLimited, 403/404 -> invalidArguments, size/sha256 mismatch -> invalidArguments. No deferred fetching; serverFail reused.
